name: Morojeotaegui Bimil
source:
Antoine de Moreau suffers from a typical murder-mystery dilemma. He’s the heir to a large fortune, but he is also under suspicion of having murdered the person who bequeathed it to him. To clear the check, he must clear his name, and to do that he must find out who actually killed his foster father.

[Edited from the App Store]
